en: Press {info} any time. Everything with an outline can be explained. The codec remembers all you have found: open it in info mode or the pause menu. Curious is good, friend.
pt-BR: Aperte {info} quando quiser. Tudo com contorno pode ser explicado. O codec lembra tudo que você achou: abra no modo info ou no menu de pausa. Curiosidade é bom, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Replaces angler.topic.info.say: the codec can now be opened from info mode too.
fr: Appuie sur {info} quand tu veux. Tout ce qui a un contour s'explique. Le codec garde tout ce que tu as trouvé : ouvre-le en mode info ou dans le menu pause. Sois curieux, l'ami.
de: Drück jederzeit {info}. Alles mit Umriss lässt sich erklären. Der Codec merkt sich alles, was du gefunden hast: im Infomodus oder im Pausemenü. Neugier ist gut, Freund.
pl: Wciśnij {info}, kiedy chcesz. Wszystko z obwódką da się wyjaśnić. Kodeks pamięta wszystko, co masz: otwórz go w trybie info lub w menu pauzy. Ciekawość jest dobra, przyjacielu.

en: Which way are the fish looking?
pt-BR: Pra que lado os peixes olham?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters).
fr: De quel côté regardent les poissons ?
de: Wohin schauen die Fische?
pl: W którą stronę patrzą ryby?

en: Every fish faces left or right. Swap across, and the fish you carry faces the way you carried it, and the one you shove faces the way it was shoved. Up or down? Nobody turns.
pt-BR: Todo peixe olha pra esquerda ou direita. Troque de lado, e o que você leva olha pra onde foi levado, e o empurrado pra onde foi empurrado. Pra cima ou baixo? Ninguém vira.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Chaque poisson regarde à gauche ou à droite. Échange de côté : celui que tu portes regarde où tu l'as porté, celui que tu pousses, où il a été poussé. Haut ou bas ? Personne ne tourne.
de: Jeder Fisch schaut nach links oder rechts. Tauschst du quer, schaut der getragene, wohin du ihn trägst, und der geschubste, wohin er geschubst wird. Hoch oder runter? Keiner dreht sich.
pl: Każda ryba patrzy w lewo albo w prawo. Zamień w poziomie: niesiona patrzy tam, dokąd ją niesiesz, a odepchnięta tam, dokąd ją odepchnięto. W górę lub w dół? Nikt się nie obraca.

en: Crabs, starfish, jellies, stingrays and bottles look the same both ways, so they never face anything. Crabs walk sideways anyway. Show-offs. Face forward, pal.
pt-BR: Caranguejos, estrelas, águas-vivas, arraias e garrafas são iguais dos dois lados, então nunca olham pra lado nenhum. Caranguejo anda de lado mesmo. Olhe pra frente, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Crabes, étoiles, méduses, raies et bouteilles sont pareils des deux côtés, alors ils ne regardent nulle part. Les crabes marchent de travers, de toute façon. Regarde devant, mon vieux.
de: Krabben, Seesterne, Quallen, Rochen und Flaschen sehen von beiden Seiten gleich aus, also schauen sie nirgendwohin. Krabben laufen eh seitwärts. Blick nach vorn, Kumpel.
pl: Kraby, rozgwiazdy, meduzy, płaszczki i butelki wyglądają tak samo z obu stron, więc nigdzie nie patrzą. Kraby i tak chodzą bokiem. Pozerzy. Patrz przed siebie, stary.

en: What is a school?
pt-BR: O que é um cardume?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters).
fr: C'est quoi, un banc ?
de: Was ist ein Schwarm?
pl: Co to jest ławica?

en: Swap three or more fish of a kind together, all facing the same way, and they do not pop. They swim off together, way out into the blue. Same points! Fancier exit!
pt-BR: Junte numa troca três ou mais peixes da mesma espécie, todos olhando pro mesmo lado, e eles não estouram. Nadam juntos pra longe, no azul. Mesmos pontos! Saída mais chique!
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Réunis trois poissons d'une espèce ou plus, tous tournés du même côté, et ils n'éclatent pas. Ils filent ensemble, loin dans le bleu. Mêmes points ! Sortie plus chic !
de: Tausch drei oder mehr Fische einer Art zusammen, alle in dieselbe Richtung, und sie platzen nicht. Sie schwimmen zusammen davon, hinaus ins Blaue. Gleiche Punkte! Schickerer Abgang!
pl: Połącz zamianą trzy lub więcej ryb jednego gatunku, patrzące w tę samą stronę, a nie zostaną zbite. Odpłyną razem w błękit. Te same punkty! Elegantsze wyjście!

en: Fish that only fall together do not count: your swap has to make it. Unless you have the fall in line card. Then falling counts too. Crabs never school. School them, buddy.
pt-BR: Peixes que só caem juntos não contam: sua troca tem que formar. A não ser com a carta entrar na linha. Aí cair também conta. Caranguejo nunca forma cardume. Manda ver, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Des poissons qui tombent ensemble ne comptent pas : ton échange doit le faire. Sauf avec la carte en rang : là, tomber compte aussi. Les crabes ne font jamais de banc. Vas-y, l'ami.
de: Fische, die nur zusammen fallen, zählen nicht: Dein Tausch muss es machen. Außer mit der Karte eingereiht, dann zählt Fallen auch. Krabben schwärmen nie. Schwärm los, Freund.
pl: Ryby, które tylko razem spadną, się nie liczą: musi to zrobić twoja zamiana. Chyba że masz kartę w szeregu, wtedy spadanie też się liczy. Kraby nie tworzą ławic. Do dzieła!

en: Who is out there in the distance?
pt-BR: Quem está lá longe?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters).
fr: Qui est là-bas, au loin ?
de: Wer ist da draußen in der Ferne?
pl: Kto tam jest w oddali?

en: The schools you send off wait out there with their kind. Rest the cursor on a fish, and its kind swims closer to watch. Pop a match with that fish, and they all pop too!
pt-BR: Os cardumes que você manda embora esperam lá longe. Pare o cursor num peixe, e a espécie dele chega perto pra olhar. Estoure um grupo com esse peixe, e todos estouram junto!
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Les bancs que tu envoies attendent là-bas. Pose le curseur sur un poisson, et son espèce s'approche pour regarder. Fais éclater un groupe avec lui, et ils éclatent tous !
de: Deine Schwärme warten da draußen bei ihrer Art. Lass den Cursor auf einem Fisch, und seine Art kommt näher, um zuzuschauen. Lass mit ihm eine Gruppe platzen, und alle platzen mit!
pl: Odesłane ławice czekają w oddali. Zatrzymaj kursor na rybie, a jej gatunek podpłynie bliżej popatrzeć. Zbij z tą rybą grupę, a wszystkie tamte też zostaną zbite!

en: But step off that fish without a match, and its kind gets bored and swims away for good. Make a new school of it, and they wait for more. Careful where you wander, friend.
pt-BR: Mas saia desse peixe sem formar grupo, e a espécie dele se cansa e vai embora pra sempre. Forme um novo cardume com ele, e eles esperam mais. Cuidado por onde anda, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Mais quitte ce poisson sans groupe, et son espèce s'ennuie et s'en va pour de bon. Fais-en un nouveau banc, et ils attendent la suite. Attention où tu te promènes, l'ami.
de: Aber geh ohne Gruppe von dem Fisch runter, und seine Art langweilt sich und schwimmt für immer weg. Mach einen neuen Schwarm daraus, und sie warten auf mehr. Pass auf, Freund.
pl: Ale zejdź z tej ryby bez grupy, a jej gatunek się znudzi i odpłynie na dobre. Zrób z niej nową ławicę, a poczekają na więcej. Uważaj, dokąd chodzisz, przyjacielu.

en: What is a rainbow fish?
pt-BR: O que é um peixe arco-íris?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters).
fr: C'est quoi, un poisson arc-en-ciel ?
de: Was ist ein Regenbogenfisch?
pl: Co to jest tęczowa ryba?

en: Pop a group of five or more, and the fish under your cursor turns rainbow! Still its own kind, and it matches its own kind, but it is worth more when it pops. Shiny show-off.
pt-BR: Estoure um grupo de cinco ou mais, e o peixe sob o cursor vira arco-íris! Continua da mesma espécie e combina com ela, mas vale mais quando estoura. Exibido brilhante.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Fais éclater un groupe de cinq ou plus, et le poisson sous ton curseur devient arc-en-ciel ! Il reste de son espèce, mais il vaut plus quand il éclate. Frimeur brillant.
de: Lass fünf oder mehr platzen, und der Fisch unter deinem Cursor wird zum Regenbogen! Er bleibt seine Art und passt zu ihr, ist aber mehr wert, wenn er platzt. Glänzender Angeber.
pl: Zbij grupę pięciu lub więcej, a ryba pod kursorem stanie się tęczowa! Dalej jest swojego gatunku i do niego pasuje, ale zbita jest warta więcej. Lśniący pozer.

en: Pop a group beside a rainbow, and a ribbon of rainbow flows to your cursor and makes another. Three rainbows touching pop together, whatever kind. Wild! Shine on, pal.
pt-BR: Estoure um grupo ao lado de um arco-íris, e uma fita corre até o cursor e faz outro. Três arco-íris encostados estouram juntos, de qualquer espécie. Coringa! Brilhe, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Fais éclater un groupe près d'un arc-en-ciel, et un ruban file jusqu'à ton curseur pour en faire un autre. Trois qui se touchent éclatent ensemble. Joker ! Brille, mon vieux.
de: Lass eine Gruppe neben einem Regenbogen platzen, und ein Band fließt zu deinem Cursor und macht noch einen. Drei, die sich berühren, platzen zusammen. Wild! Leuchte, Kumpel.
pl: Zbij grupę obok tęczowej, a wstęga popłynie do kursora i zrobi tam kolejną. Trzy stykające się tęczowe zostaną zbite razem, bez względu na gatunek. Dzikie! Świeć, stary.

en: What happens to old rainbows?
pt-BR: O que acontece com os arco-íris velhos?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters).
fr: Que deviennent les vieux arcs-en-ciel ?
de: Was wird aus alten Regenbögen?
pl: Co się dzieje ze starymi tęczowymi?

en: Pop five or more while rainbows are about, and every one of them bursts, and takes any pair beside it along. Then your cursor fish becomes the new rainbow. Kaboom, buddy.
pt-BR: Estoure cinco ou mais com arco-íris por perto, e todos eles explodem, levando junto qualquer par do lado. Depois o peixe do cursor vira o novo arco-íris. Kabum, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Fais éclater cinq poissons ou plus avec des arcs-en-ciel autour : ils éclatent tous, et emportent toute paire voisine. Puis ton poisson sous le curseur devient arc-en-ciel. Boum, l'ami.
de: Lass fünf oder mehr platzen, während Regenbögen da sind, und jeder zerplatzt und nimmt jedes Paar neben sich mit. Dann wird dein Cursorfisch der neue Regenbogen. Kawumm, Freund.
pl: Zbij pięć lub więcej, gdy w pobliżu są tęczowe, a każda wybuchnie i zabierze każdą parę obok. Potem ryba pod kursorem stanie się nową tęczową. Bum, przyjacielu.

en: How many rounds are there?
pt-BR: Quantas rodadas são?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters).
fr: Combien y a-t-il de manches ?
de: Wie viele Runden gibt es?
pl: Ile jest rund?

en: That number counts the rounds you have left. Win the last one, and the game ends: the fish swim home, all but the ones with a coral home. Long goodbyes make me soggy.
pt-BR: Esse número conta as rodadas que faltam. Vença a última, e o jogo acaba: os peixes nadam pra casa, menos os que têm lar de coral. Despedidas longas me deixam encharcado.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Ce nombre compte les manches qui restent. Gagne la dernière, et c'est fini : les poissons rentrent chez eux, sauf ceux qui ont un foyer de corail. Les longs adieux me mouillent.
de: Die Zahl zählt deine übrigen Runden. Gewinn die letzte, und das Spiel endet: Die Fische schwimmen heim, bis auf die mit Korallenzuhause. Lange Abschiede machen mich nass.
pl: Ta liczba liczy rundy, które ci zostały. Wygraj ostatnią, a gra się skończy: ryby popłyną do domu, poza tymi z domem na koralowcu. Długie pożegnania mnie rozmiękczają.

en: What are the krill for?
pt-BR: Pra que serve o krill?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the krill that the Whale Krill quest puts on the board.
fr: À quoi sert le krill ?
de: Wofür ist der Krill?
pl: Po co jest kryl?

en: Krill! Teeny and tasty, and three in a row pop like any fish. But while the whale wants them, a pop with krill in it scores nothing. Save them for the whale, pal.
pt-BR: Krill! Miudinhos e gostosos, e três em linha estouram como qualquer peixe. Mas enquanto a baleia os quer, um estouro com krill não vale nada. Guarde pra baleia, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Krill match like any fish, but while the Whale Krill quest is on, a group with krill in it scores nothing.
fr: Du krill ! Minuscule et savoureux, et trois en ligne éclatent comme n'importe quel poisson. Mais tant que la baleine en veut, un groupe avec du krill ne rapporte rien. Garde-le pour elle, mon vieux.
de: Krill! Winzig und lecker, und drei in einer Reihe platzen wie jeder Fisch. Aber solange der Wal ihn will, bringt ein Platzer mit Krill nichts. Heb ihn für den Wal auf, Kumpel.
pl: Kryl! Malutki i smaczny, a trzy w rzędzie zbijają się jak każda ryba. Ale póki wieloryb go chce, zbicie z krylem nic nie daje. Zostaw go dla wieloryba, kolego.

en: Why is seaweed growing?
pt-BR: Por que a alga está crescendo?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the seaweed of the Seaweed quest.
fr: Pourquoi l'algue pousse-t-elle ?
de: Warum wächst da Seetang?
pl: Czemu rosną wodorosty?

en: A quest! Pop on the bottom row to plant it, and pop right on top of it to make it grow. Get two to the top. Swap a piece, and the rest snaps off. Gentle, buddy.
pt-BR: Uma missão! Estoure na última fileira pra plantar, e estoure bem em cima dela pra crescer. Leve duas até o topo. Troque um pedaço, e o resto se quebra. Com jeito, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. The Seaweed quest: pops on the bottom row plant seaweed, pops on top of it grow it; two must reach the top row; swapping a piece breaks the rest.
fr: Une quête ! Fais éclater sur la rangée du bas pour la planter, et juste au-dessus pour la faire pousser. Monte-en deux jusqu'en haut. Échange un bout, et le reste casse. Doucement, mon vieux.
de: Eine Quest! Lass in der untersten Reihe etwas platzen, um ihn zu pflanzen, und direkt darüber, damit er wächst. Bring zwei nach oben. Tausch ein Stück, und der Rest bricht ab. Sanft, Kumpel.
pl: Zadanie! Zbijaj w dolnym rzędzie, żeby je posadzić, i tuż nad nimi, żeby rosły. Doprowadź dwa do góry. Zamień kawałek, a reszta się urwie. Delikatnie, kolego.

en: What is the sand dollar for?
pt-BR: Pra que serve a bolacha-da-praia?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the sand dollar of the Left to Right quest.
fr: À quoi sert le dollar des sables ?
de: Wofür ist der Sanddollar?
pl: Po co jest dolar piaskowy?

en: Swap it all the way to the right edge. A swap that moves it and pops nothing cracks it, and so does the bottom row. Flat, round, and worth nothing. Like my jokes, friend.
pt-BR: Troque-a até a borda direita. Uma troca que a move sem estourar nada a racha, e a última fileira também. Achatada, redonda, e não vale nada. Igual às minhas piadas, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. The Left to Right quest. The joke: a sand dollar is not money, and neither are the angler's jokes worth anything.
fr: Échange-le jusqu'au bord droit. Un échange qui le bouge sans rien faire éclater le fend, et la rangée du bas aussi. Plat, rond, et sans valeur. Comme mes blagues, l'ami.
de: Tausch ihn bis an den rechten Rand. Ein Tausch, der ihn bewegt und nichts platzen lässt, zerbricht ihn, und die unterste Reihe auch. Flach, rund, nichts wert. Wie meine Witze, Freund.
pl: Przesuwaj go zamianami do prawej krawędzi. Zamiana, która go rusza i nic nie zbija, łamie go, tak samo dolny rząd. Płaski, okrągły i nic niewart. Jak moje żarty, przyjacielu.

en: Where is the turtle going?
pt-BR: Pra onde vai a tartaruga?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the turtle of the Turtle quest.
fr: Où va la tortue ?
de: Wohin will die Schildkröte?
pl: Dokąd idzie żółw?

en: Right! After each swap, it steps right, onto the kind of fish it shows. You cannot swap it. Line up its fish and let it plod to the edge. Slow and steady, pal.
pt-BR: Pra direita! Depois de cada troca, ela anda pra direita, sobre o tipo de peixe que mostra. Não dá pra trocá-la. Alinhe os peixes dela e deixe-a ir até a borda. Devagar e sempre, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. The Turtle quest: after each swap the turtle steps right onto the kind of fish it shows; it cannot be swapped; it must reach the right edge.
fr: À droite ! Après chaque échange, elle avance à droite, sur l'espèce de poisson qu'elle montre. Impossible de l'échanger. Aligne ses poissons et laisse-la trotter jusqu'au bord. Lentement, mon vieux.
de: Nach rechts! Nach jedem Tausch tritt sie nach rechts, auf die Fischart, die sie zeigt. Tauschen kannst du sie nicht. Leg ihre Fische zurecht und lass sie zum Rand stapfen. Langsam, Kumpel.
pl: W prawo! Po każdej zamianie robi krok w prawo, na rybę z gatunku, który pokazuje. Nie da się go zamienić. Ułóż mu ryby i pozwól mu dreptać do krawędzi. Powoli, kolego.

en: Can I swap the glass fish?
pt-BR: Dá pra trocar o peixe de vidro?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the glass fish of the Glass Fish quest.
fr: Je peux échanger le poisson de verre ?
de: Kann ich den Glasfisch tauschen?
pl: Mogę zamienić szklaną rybę?

en: No, too fragile! Pop the fish under it, and it sinks. Get it to the bottom row. But if it drops two cells at once, it shatters. Tinkle, tinkle. Careful, buddy.
pt-BR: Não, frágil demais! Estoure os peixes embaixo dele, e ele desce. Leve-o até a última fileira. Mas se cair duas casas de uma vez, ele se quebra. Plim, plim. Cuidado, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. The Glass Fish quest: it cannot be swapped; popping fish under it lowers it; it must reach the bottom row; it shatters if it falls two cells at once.
fr: Non, trop fragile ! Fais éclater les poissons dessous, et il descend. Amène-le sur la rangée du bas. Mais s'il tombe de deux cases d'un coup, il se brise. Ding, ding. Prudence, mon vieux.
de: Nein, zu zerbrechlich! Lass die Fische darunter platzen, und er sinkt. Bring ihn in die unterste Reihe. Fällt er zwei Felder auf einmal, zerspringt er. Klirr, klirr. Vorsicht, Kumpel.
pl: Nie, za delikatna! Zbijaj ryby pod nią, a opadnie. Doprowadź ją do dolnego rzędu. Ale jeśli spadnie o dwa pola naraz, roztrzaska się. Brzdęk, brzdęk. Ostrożnie, kolego.

en: Why do some fish wear rings?
pt-BR: Por que alguns peixes têm anel?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About a fish with a ring on it, put there by the quest of the round. Use the quests' word for 'ringed'.
fr: Pourquoi des poissons sont cerclés ?
de: Warum sind manche Fische beringt?
pl: Czemu ryby mają obręcze?

en: A ring means the quest has its eye on that fish. The quest says what it wants with it. The ring goes wherever the fish goes. Very fancy. I wear a light. Also fancy, friend.
pt-BR: Um anel quer dizer que a missão está de olho nesse peixe. A missão diz o que quer com ele. O anel vai aonde o peixe for. Chiquérrimo. Eu uso uma luz. Também chique, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. A ringed fish matters to the current quest, whose text says what to do with it. The ring moves with the fish. The angler 'wears' its glowing lure.
fr: Un cercle veut dire que la quête a l'œil sur ce poisson. La quête dit ce qu'elle veut en faire. Le cercle suit le poisson partout. Très chic. Moi, je porte une lumière. Chic aussi, l'ami.
de: Ein Ring heißt, die Quest hat diesen Fisch im Auge. Die Quest sagt, was sie mit ihm will. Der Ring geht mit, wohin der Fisch geht. Sehr schick. Ich trage ein Licht. Auch schick, Freund.
pl: Obręcz znaczy, że zadanie ma oko na tę rybę. Zadanie mówi, czego od niej chce. Obręcz idzie wszędzie za rybą. Bardzo elegancko. Ja noszę światło. Też elegancko, przyjacielu.

en: What is the squid doing here?
pt-BR: O que essa lula está fazendo aqui?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the squid that appears on the board at night.
fr: Que fait ce calmar ici ?
de: Was macht der Tintenfisch hier?
pl: Co tu robi ta kałamarnica?

en: At nightfall, a lonely fish turns into a squid. It never matches. Swap into it, and nothing trades places: you push it, and it squirts ink and zooms off down that line.
pt-BR: Ao anoitecer, um peixe solitário vira lula. Ela nunca combina. Troque com ela, e ninguém troca de lugar: você a empurra, e ela solta tinta e dispara por aquela linha.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. At nightfall a fish with no neighbour of its own kind becomes a squid. It never matches. Swapping with it pushes it instead: it leaves ink in its cell and shoots off along that row or column.
fr: À la tombée de la nuit, un poisson solitaire devient calmar. Il ne s'assortit jamais. Échange avec lui, et rien ne bouge : tu le pousses, il crache de l'encre et file le long de la ligne.
de: Bei Einbruch der Nacht wird ein einsamer Fisch zum Tintenfisch. Er passt zu nichts. Tauschst du mit ihm, tauscht keiner den Platz: Du schubst ihn, er spritzt Tinte und saust die Linie entlang.
pl: Gdy zapada noc, samotna ryba zmienia się w kałamarnicę. Do niczego nie pasuje. Zamień z nią, a nic się nie zamienia: pchasz ją, a ona pryska atramentem i pędzi wzdłuż tej linii.

en: Ink spreads to whatever you swap with it. When the night is over, the ink pops away, but the fish under it stay put. Inky, slinky, stinky. Shoo, squid. Night night, pal.
pt-BR: A tinta passa pra tudo que você troca com ela. Quando a noite acaba, a tinta estoura e some, mas os peixes embaixo ficam. Tintosa, manhosa, fedorosa. Xô, lula. Boa noite, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Second page. A swap with an inked cell inks the other cell too. When the night ends the ink pops away, but the fish under it do not pop.
fr: L'encre gagne tout ce que tu échanges avec elle. Quand la nuit finit, l'encre éclate et s'en va, mais les poissons dessous restent. Encreux, visqueux, malicieux. Ouste, calmar. Bonne nuit, mon vieux.
de: Tinte geht auf alles über, was du mit ihr tauschst. Ist die Nacht vorbei, platzt die Tinte weg, aber die Fische darunter bleiben. Tintig, glitschig, stinkig. Husch, Tintenfisch. Gute Nacht, Kumpel.
pl: Atrament przechodzi na wszystko, co z nim zamienisz. Gdy noc się kończy, atrament pęka i znika, ale ryby pod nim zostają. Atramentowa, śliska, śmierdząca. A sio, kałamarnico. Dobranoc, kolego.

en: How far does the squid swim?
pt-BR: Até onde a lula nada?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). A rumor: how far a pushed squid travels.
fr: Jusqu'où nage le calmar ?
de: Wie weit schwimmt der Tintenfisch?
pl: Jak daleko płynie kałamarnica?

en: Count the kinds of fish ahead of it, starting next door, until a kind comes up twice. It swims that many and lands on the last new one. Off one edge, in the other! Zoom, buddy.
pt-BR: Conte os tipos de peixe à frente dela, a partir do vizinho, até um tipo se repetir. Ela nada essa conta e para no último novo. Sai por uma borda, entra pela outra! Zum, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. The rule: walking from the squid in the push direction, count the different kinds of fish until a kind repeats; it moves that many cells, landing on the last new kind, wrapping around the board's edge.
fr: Compte les espèces devant lui, à partir du voisin, jusqu'à ce qu'une revienne. Il nage d'autant et s'arrête sur la dernière nouvelle. Il sort d'un bord, rentre par l'autre ! Zou, mon vieux.
de: Zähl die Fischarten vor ihm, ab dem Nachbarn, bis eine doppelt kommt. So weit schwimmt er und landet auf der letzten neuen. Raus am einen Rand, rein am anderen! Wusch, Kumpel.
pl: Policz gatunki ryb przed nią, od sąsiadki, aż któryś się powtórzy. Tyle pól płynie i ląduje na ostatnim nowym. Wypływa jedną krawędzią, wpływa drugą! Szszu, kolego.

en: What are the lights at night?
pt-BR: Que luzes são essas à noite?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). A deep rumor about the constellations: the drifting plankton lights beside the board at night.
fr: C'est quoi, ces lumières la nuit ?
de: Was sind die Lichter bei Nacht?
pl: Co to za światełka w nocy?

en: At night, the little lights drifting up beside the board sometimes join into a shape. Draw that shape on the board in ink, exactly, and it scores big when the night ends.
pt-BR: À noite, as luzinhas que sobem ao lado do tabuleiro às vezes formam uma figura. Desenhe essa figura no tabuleiro com tinta, exatamente, e ela pontua alto quando a noite acaba.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. At night the plankton lights beside the board sometimes form a shape (a constellation). Drawing exactly that shape in ink on the board scores a big bonus at the end of the night.
fr: La nuit, les petites lumières qui montent à côté du plateau forment parfois une figure. Dessine cette figure sur le plateau à l'encre, exactement, et elle rapporte gros à la fin de la nuit.
de: Nachts fügen sich die kleinen Lichter, die neben dem Spielfeld aufsteigen, manchmal zu einer Form. Zeichne sie genau mit Tinte aufs Spielfeld, und sie bringt am Ende der Nacht viel.
pl: Nocą światełka unoszące się obok planszy czasem układają się w kształt. Narysuj go dokładnie atramentem na planszy, a gdy noc się skończy, da dużo punktów.

en: Exactly means each piece of it is its own puddle of ink, touching no other ink at the sides. Turn it any way you like. One shape a night. Starry, inky night, friend.
pt-BR: Exatamente quer dizer que cada parte é uma poça de tinta só dela, sem encostar em outra tinta pelos lados. Gire como quiser. Uma figura por noite. Noite estrelada e tintosa, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Second page. 'Exactly': each piece of the shape is its own separate patch of ink, with no other ink touching it at a side. Any rotation works. Only one shape can be made per night.
fr: Exactement, ça veut dire que chaque morceau est sa propre flaque d'encre, sans toucher d'autre encre par les côtés. Tourne-la comme tu veux. Une figure par nuit. Nuit étoilée, l'ami.
de: Genau heißt: Jedes Stück ist eine eigene Tintenpfütze, die keine andere Tinte an den Seiten berührt. Dreh sie, wie du willst. Eine Form pro Nacht. Sternige, tintige Nacht, Freund.
pl: Dokładnie znaczy, że każdy kawałek to osobna kałuża atramentu, która bokiem nie dotyka innego atramentu. Obracaj, jak chcesz. Jeden kształt na noc. Gwiaździsta noc, przyjacielu.

en: What is the gold bar?
pt-BR: O que é a barra dourada?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the gold bar under the coral bars, which counts the pieces of a godly shape (tide.godly).
fr: C'est quoi, la barre dorée ?
de: Was ist der goldene Balken?
pl: Co to za złoty pasek?

en: Every shape you draw from the stars is a piece of something godly. One a night, five in all. Fill the gold bar, and somebody very, very big takes notice. Gulp. Bubbles, pal.
pt-BR: Cada figura que você desenha das estrelas é uma parte de algo divino. Uma por noite, cinco ao todo. Encha a barra dourada, e alguém muito, muito grande vai notar. Glup. Bolhas, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Each constellation drawn is one of five pieces of a godly shape, one per night at most. Completing all five brings a secret ending. Do NOT name the shape (it is a trident) or the god: players should discover that.
fr: Chaque figure que tu dessines d'après les étoiles est un morceau de quelque chose de divin. Une par nuit, cinq en tout. Remplis la barre dorée, et quelqu'un de très, très grand le remarquera. Glup.
de: Jede Form, die du nach den Sternen zeichnest, ist ein Teil von etwas Göttlichem. Eine pro Nacht, fünf insgesamt. Füll den goldenen Balken, und jemand sehr, sehr Großes wird aufmerksam. Schluck.
pl: Każdy kształt narysowany z gwiazd to część czegoś boskiego. Jeden na noc, pięć w sumie. Napełnij złoty pasek, a ktoś bardzo, bardzo wielki to zauważy. Gul. Bąbelki, kolego.

en: {dir} choose    {confirm} ask {$bulbs}    {info} back to game
pt-BR: {dir} escolher    {confirm} perguntar {$bulbs}    {info} voltar ao jogo
notes: Info mode hint while the list of what is on the board is open and lights are kept: choose a row, ask the angler about it, or leave info mode. {$bulbs} is one bulb icon per kept light. One line, tight; keep the four spaces.
fr: {dir} choisir    {confirm} demander {$bulbs}    {info} retour au jeu
de: {dir} wählen    {confirm} fragen {$bulbs}    {info} zum Spiel
pl: {dir} wybierz    {confirm} zapytaj {$bulbs}    {info} do gry

en: Ink spreads to whatever you swap with it. When the night ends, the ink pops, cell by cell, and pays a little for each. The fish under it stay put. Shoo, squid. Night night, pal.
pt-BR: A tinta passa pra tudo que você troca com ela. Quando a noite acaba, a tinta estoura, casa por casa, e paga um pouquinho por cada. Os peixes embaixo ficam. Xô, lula. Boa noite, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Second page about the squid. A night swap with an inked cell inks the other cell too. When the night ends the ink pops away cell by cell and scores a little for each cell; the fish under it do not pop. Replaces angler.topic.squid.more.
fr: L'encre gagne tout ce que tu échanges avec elle. À la fin de la nuit, elle éclate, case par case, et rapporte un peu pour chacune. Les poissons dessous restent. Ouste, calmar. Bonne nuit, mon vieux.
de: Tinte geht auf alles über, was du mit ihr tauschst. Endet die Nacht, platzt sie Feld für Feld und bringt für jedes ein bisschen. Die Fische darunter bleiben. Husch, Tintenfisch. Gute Nacht, Kumpel.
pl: Atrament przechodzi na wszystko, co z nim zamienisz. Gdy noc się kończy, pęka pole po polu i za każde trochę płaci. Ryby pod nim zostają. A sio, kałamarnico. Dobranoc, kolego.

en: Exactly means the ink is that shape and no more: no other ink touching it at a side. Corners are fine. Turn it any way you like. One shape a night. Paint away, friend.
pt-BR: Exatamente quer dizer que a tinta é essa figura e nada mais: nenhuma outra tinta encostando pelos lados. Pelas pontas, tudo bem. Gire como quiser. Uma figura por noite. Pinte, amigo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. The shapes are PAINTED IN INK on the board, copied from lights in the water: never say they are made of stars, or drawn in the stars. Second page about the shapes. 'Exactly': the ink is that shape and nothing more; other ink may touch it at a corner but not at a side. Any rotation works. Only one shape can be made per night. Replaces angler.topic.stars.more.
fr: Exactement, ça veut dire que l'encre fait cette forme et rien de plus : aucune autre encre ne la touche par un côté. Les coins, ça va. Tourne-la comme tu veux. Une par nuit. Peins, l'ami.
de: Genau heißt: Die Tinte ist diese Form und nicht mehr, keine andere Tinte berührt sie an einer Seite. Ecken sind okay. Dreh sie, wie du willst. Eine Form pro Nacht. Mal los, Freund.
pl: Dokładnie znaczy, że atrament to ten kształt i nic więcej: żaden inny atrament nie dotyka go bokiem. Rogami można. Obracaj, jak chcesz. Jeden kształt na noc. Maluj, przyjacielu.

en: Every shape you paint in ink, copied from the lights, is a piece of something godly. One a night, five in all. Fill the gold bar, and somebody very, very big takes notice. Gulp, pal.
pt-BR: Cada figura que você pinta com tinta, copiada das luzes, é uma parte de algo divino. Uma por noite, cinco ao todo. Encha a barra dourada, e alguém muito, muito grande vai notar. Glup, chapa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. The shapes are PAINTED IN INK on the board, copied from lights in the water: never say they are made of stars, or drawn in the stars. About the gold bar under the coral bars. Each shape painted is one of five pieces of a godly shape, one per night at most. Completing all five brings a secret ending. Do NOT name the shape (it is a trident) or the god. Replaces angler.topic.godly.say.
fr: Chaque forme que tu peins à l'encre, d'après les lumières, est un morceau de quelque chose de divin. Une par nuit, cinq en tout. Remplis la barre dorée, et quelqu'un de très, très grand le remarquera.
de: Jede Form, die du nach den Lichtern mit Tinte malst, ist ein Teil von etwas Göttlichem. Eine pro Nacht, fünf insgesamt. Füll den goldenen Balken, und jemand sehr, sehr Großes wird aufmerksam.
pl: Każdy kształt namalowany atramentem według świateł to część czegoś boskiego. Jeden na noc, pięć w sumie. Napełnij złoty pasek, a ktoś bardzo, bardzo wielki to zauważy. Gul, kolego.

en: Ink spreads to whatever you swap with it, night or day. At dawn it dries and stays. Pop the fish on it to wash it off. Wash it all before dark, and it pays big. Shoo, squid.
pt-BR: A tinta passa pra tudo que você troca com ela, de noite ou de dia. De manhã ela seca e fica. Estoure os peixes em cima pra lavar. Lave tudo antes de escurecer e ganhe muito. Xô, lula.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Second page about the squid. A swap with an inked cell inks the other cell too, by night or by day. At dawn the ink left dries and stays on the board; popping a fish on an inked cell washes that cell. Washing ALL of it before night falls pays a big score. Replaces angler.topic.squid.more2.
fr: L'encre gagne tout ce que tu échanges avec elle, nuit et jour. À l'aube, elle sèche et reste. Fais éclater les poissons dessus pour la laver. Lave tout avant la nuit : ça paie gros. Ouste, calmar.
de: Tinte geht auf alles über, was du mit ihr tauschst, Tag und Nacht. Bei Tagesanbruch trocknet sie. Lass Fische darauf platzen, das wäscht sie ab. Alles weg vor der Nacht? Das zahlt sich aus. Husch!
pl: Atrament przechodzi na wszystko, co z nim zamienisz, w dzień i w nocy. O świcie zasycha i zostaje. Zbijaj ryby na nim, żeby go zmyć. Zmyj wszystko przed zmrokiem, a dużo zarobisz. A sio, kałamarnico.

en: Drag ink and it comes along. Push into it and it slides on ahead. At dawn it dries. Pop fish on it to wash it: each cell you wash glows. Wash it all before dark to cash in the glow.
pt-BR: Arraste a tinta e ela vem junto. Empurre e ela desliza à frente. De manhã ela seca. Estoure peixes nela pra lavar: cada casa lavada brilha. Lave tudo antes da noite e lucre com o brilho.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Second page about the squid. A swap that starts on an inked cell drags the ink along to the next cell; a swap into an inked cell pushes that ink one cell further on. At dawn the ink left dries and stays; popping a fish on an inked cell washes it, and every washed cell glows. Washing ALL the ink before night falls pays for every glowing cell. Replaces angler.topic.squid.more3.
fr: Traîne l'encre, elle te suit. Pousse dedans, elle glisse devant. À l'aube, elle sèche. Fais éclater les poissons dessus : chaque case lavée brille. Lave tout avant la nuit pour encaisser.
de: Zieh Tinte, sie kommt mit. Schieb hinein, sie rutscht weiter. Bei Tagesanbruch trocknet sie. Lass Fische darauf platzen: jedes gewaschene Feld leuchtet. Alles weg vor der Nacht? Kassieren!
pl: Ciągnij atrament, a pójdzie z tobą. Pchnij go, a przesunie się dalej. O świcie zasycha. Zbijaj ryby na nim: każde zmyte pole lśni. Zmyj wszystko przed zmrokiem i zgarnij blask.

en: Drag ink and it comes along, night or day. At dawn it dries. Pop fish on it to wash it: each cell you wash sparkles. Wash it all before dark to cash in the sparkle. Shoo, squid.
pt-BR: Arraste a tinta e ela vem junto, de noite ou de dia. De manhã ela seca. Estoure peixes nela pra lavar: cada casa lavada brilha. Lave tudo antes da noite e lucre com o brilho. Xô, lula.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Second page about the squid. A swap that starts on an inked cell drags the ink along to the next cell, by night or by day. At dawn the ink left dries and stays; popping a fish on an inked cell washes it, and every washed cell sparkles, squeaky clean. Washing ALL the ink before night falls pays for every sparkling cell. Replaces angler.topic.squid.more4.
fr: Traîne l'encre, elle te suit, nuit et jour. À l'aube, elle sèche. Fais éclater les poissons dessus : chaque case lavée brille. Lave tout avant la nuit pour encaisser. Ouste, calmar.
de: Zieh Tinte, sie kommt mit, Tag und Nacht. Bei Tagesanbruch trocknet sie. Lass Fische darauf platzen: jedes gewaschene Feld glänzt. Alles weg vor der Nacht? Kassieren! Husch!
pl: Ciągnij atrament, a pójdzie z tobą, w dzień i w nocy. O świcie zasycha. Zbijaj ryby na nim: każde zmyte pole lśni. Zmyj wszystko przed zmrokiem i zgarnij blask. A sio, kałamarnico.

en: What do I do with ink in the day?
pt-BR: O que faço com a tinta de dia?
notes: A question the player picks, one line in the angler's box: keep it short (about 40 letters). About the ink that is left on the board in the day.
fr: Que faire de l'encre le jour ?
de: Was mache ich tagsüber mit Tinte?
pl: Co robić z atramentem za dnia?

en: Ink left at dawn dries. Pop fish on it to wash it, and the cell sparkles. Drag ink onto new cells and wash those too. Clean it ALL before dark, and every sparkle pays!
pt-BR: A tinta que sobra de manhã seca. Estoure peixes nela pra lavar, e a casa brilha. Arraste a tinta pra casas novas e lave também. Limpe TUDO antes de escurecer, e cada brilho paga!
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Ink left at dawn stays, dried. Popping a fish on an inked cell washes it and the cell sparkles. Dragging the ink onto cells that have not been washed yet and washing them too makes more sparkling cells. If ALL the ink is washed before night, every sparkling cell scores.
fr: L'encre qui reste à l'aube sèche. Fais éclater des poissons dessus pour la laver, et la case brille. Traîne l'encre sur d'autres cases et lave-les aussi. Lave TOUT avant la nuit : chaque éclat rapporte !
de: Tinte, die bei Tagesanbruch bleibt, trocknet. Lass Fische darauf platzen, dann glänzt das Feld. Zieh Tinte auf neue Felder und wasch die auch. Alles sauber vor der Nacht? Jedes Glänzen zahlt!
pl: Atrament z nocy o świcie zasycha. Zbijaj na nim ryby, by go zmyć, a pole lśni. Ciągnij atrament na nowe pola i zmywaj je też. Wyczyść WSZYSTKO przed zmrokiem, a każdy blask płaci!

en: Washing the same cell twice gets you nothing, kiddo. Coral hates ink by day: drag it at coral and it just bubbles away. Still inky at nightfall? You lose the lot.
pt-BR: Lavar a mesma casa duas vezes não dá nada, chapa. O coral odeia tinta de dia: arraste pra ele e ela vira bolha. Ainda com tinta ao anoitecer? Você perde tudo.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them. Second page. A cell only counts once, however often it is washed. By day, ink dragged onto coral breaks up into bubbles and is gone. If any ink is left when night falls, the whole pot is lost.
fr: Laver deux fois la même case ne rapporte rien, mon vieux. Le corail déteste l'encre le jour : traîne-la vers lui, elle part en bulles. Encore de l'encre à la nuit ? Tu perds tout.
de: Dasselbe Feld zweimal waschen bringt nichts, Kumpel. Koralle hasst Tinte am Tag: zieh sie hin, und sie blubbert weg. Noch Tinte bei Nacht? Dann ist alles weg.
pl: Dwa razy to samo pole nic nie daje, kolego. Koral nie znosi atramentu za dnia: pociągnij go tam, a rozpłynie się w bąbelkach. Atrament o zmroku? Tracisz wszystko.

en: Every swap that pops something slaps a step into the little bar, and so does every chain that falls from it. Fill it, and the multiplier goes up one! Then it wants three more. Greedy, greedy bar.
pt-BR: Cada troca que estoura algo põe um degrau na barrinha, e cada cadeia que cai dela também. Encha, e o multiplicador sobe um! Aí ela quer mais três. Barra gulosa, gulosa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Chaque échange qui fait éclater quelque chose ajoute un cran à la petite barre, comme chaque chaîne qui en tombe. Remplis-la, et le multiplicateur monte d'un ! Puis elle en veut trois de plus. Barre gourmande, gourmande.
de: Jeder Tausch, der etwas platzen lässt, klatscht eine Stufe in den kleinen Balken, und jede Kette daraus auch. Ist er voll, steigt der Multiplikator um eins! Dann will er drei mehr. Gieriger, gieriger Balken.
pl: Każda zamiana, która coś zbija, wbija krok do małego paska, tak samo jak każdy łańcuch, który z niej spada. Napełnij go, a mnożnik rośnie o jeden! Potem chce trzy więcej. Chciwy, chciwy pasek.

en: Every group that your swap pops slaps a step into the little bar, and so does every group that falls and pops after it. Fill it, and the multiplier goes up one! Then it wants three more. Greedy bar.
pt-BR: Cada grupo que a sua troca estoura põe um degrau na barrinha, e cada grupo que cai e estoura depois também. Encha, e o multiplicador sobe um! Aí ela quer mais três. Barra gulosa.
notes: An answer page, about 200 letters at most. Keep ... as three dots, and ? and ! at word ends: the voice uses them.
fr: Chaque groupe que ton échange fait éclater ajoute un cran à la petite barre, comme chaque groupe qui tombe et éclate ensuite. Remplis-la, et le multiplicateur monte d'un ! Puis elle en veut trois de plus. Barre gourmande.
de: Jede Gruppe, die dein Tausch platzen lässt, klatscht eine Stufe in den kleinen Balken, und jede, die danach fällt und platzt, auch. Ist er voll, steigt der Multiplikator um eins! Dann will er drei mehr. Gieriger Balken.
pl: Każda grupa zbita twoją zamianą wbija krok do małego paska, tak samo jak każda, która potem spadnie i pęknie. Napełnij go, a mnożnik rośnie o jeden! Potem chce trzy więcej. Chciwy pasek.

en: Howdy..
pt-BR: Oi..
notes: The anglerfish, greeting the player at the upgrade screen. It never blocks anything, so it is very gentle, almost mumbled. One short line.
fr: Salut..
de: Hallo..
pl: Cześć..

en: You're still here?
pt-BR: Você ainda está aqui?
notes: The anglerfish, greeting the player at the upgrade screen. It never blocks anything, so it is very gentle, almost mumbled. One short line.
fr: Tu es encore là ?
de: Du bist noch hier?
pl: Jeszcze tu jesteś?

en: Oh. It's you again.
pt-BR: Ah. Você de novo.
notes: The anglerfish, greeting the player at the upgrade screen. It never blocks anything, so it is very gentle, almost mumbled. One short line.
fr: Oh. Encore toi.
de: Oh. Du schon wieder.
pl: O. To znowu ty.

en: Just looking? Go on.
pt-BR: Só olhando? Vá em frente.
notes: The anglerfish, greeting the player at the upgrade screen. It never blocks anything, so it is very gentle, almost mumbled. One short line.
fr: Tu regardes ? Vas-y.
de: Nur am Schauen? Nur zu.
pl: Tylko patrzysz? Śmiało.

en: Ask me something, if you like. One question is free.
pt-BR: Pergunte algo, se quiser. Uma pergunta é de graça.
notes: The anglerfish at the first upgrade screen, telling the player that it can be asked one free question on this screen. One or two lines, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Demande-moi quelque chose, si tu veux. Une question est gratuite.
de: Frag mich etwas, wenn du magst. Eine Frage ist umsonst.
pl: Zapytaj o coś, jeśli chcesz. Jedno pytanie jest za darmo.

en: That one was free. The rest is not!
pt-BR: Essa foi de graça. O resto não é!
notes: The anglerfish, when the player asks a second question on the same upgrade screen. Only one is free per screen; it sells the rest through a card.
fr: Celle-là était gratuite. Pas le reste !
de: Die war umsonst. Der Rest nicht!
pl: To było za darmo. Reszta nie!

en: {info} ask
pt-BR: {info} perguntar
notes: Under the anglerfish on the upgrade screen: the key that asks it a question. Very short: about 62 px wide at 16 px, including the key picture. Keep {info}.
fr: {info} demander
de: {info} fragen
pl: {info} zapytaj

en: Ask me about something you've seen. One is free. Don't get used to it.
pt-BR: Pergunte sobre algo que você viu. Uma é de graça. Não se acostume.
notes: The anglerfish at the first upgrade screen. It is stingy. One question is free on every upgrade screen. One or two lines, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Demande-moi quelque chose que tu as vu. Une question est gratuite. Ne t'y habitue pas.
de: Frag mich nach etwas, das du gesehen hast. Eine Frage ist umsonst. Gewöhn dich nicht dran.
pl: Zapytaj o coś, co widzisz. Jedno pytanie za darmo. Nie przyzwyczajaj się.

en: You have asked about all you've seen. Go see more.
pt-BR: Você já perguntou sobre tudo o que viu. Vá ver mais.
notes: The anglerfish at the upgrade screen, when the player asks but there is nothing new to ask about.
fr: Tu m'as tout demandé sur ce que tu as vu. Va en voir plus.
de: Du hast nach allem gefragt, was du gesehen hast. Sieh dich weiter um.
pl: Pytanie o wszystko, co widzisz, już padło. Rozejrzyj się dalej.

en: Got a question? Ask me one. Just one. We are pacing ourselves.
pt-BR: Tem uma pergunta? Faça uma. Só uma. Vamos com calma.
notes: The anglerfish at the first upgrade screen. It answers one question on every upgrade screen. Yoga-instructor voice. One or two lines, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Une question ? Pose-m'en une. Une seule. On y va doucement.
de: Eine Frage? Stell mir eine. Nur eine. Wir machen langsam.
pl: Masz pytanie? Zadaj jedno. Tylko jedno. Spokojnie, po kolei.

en: One at a time. Breathe. Ask me at the next one.
pt-BR: Uma de cada vez. Respire. Pergunte na próxima.
notes: The anglerfish, when the player asks a second question on the same upgrade screen. Yoga-instructor voice.
fr: Une à la fois. Respire. Demande-moi à la prochaine.
de: Eins nach dem anderen. Atmen. Frag mich beim nächsten Mal.
pl: Po jednym. Oddychaj. Zapytaj przy następnym.

en: You stayed. I did tell you not to.
pt-BR: Você ficou. Eu bem que avisei.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Tu ne m'as pas écoutée. Je t'avais dit de partir.
de: Du bist geblieben. Dabei habe ich es dir gesagt.
pl: Jednak tu jesteś. A mówiłam, żeby tego nie robić.

en: Well. I made you something. Clear the water, and we can look at nothing together.
pt-BR: Bom. Fiz uma coisa pra você. Limpe a água, e a gente olha pro nada junto.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Bon. Je t'ai préparé quelque chose. Vide l'eau, et on regardera le néant ensemble.
de: Na gut. Ich habe dir etwas gemacht. Mach das Wasser leer, dann schauen wir zusammen ins Nichts.
pl: No dobrze. Coś dla ciebie zrobiłam. Oczyść wodę, a popatrzymy razem na nic.

en: There. Nothing at all. Same time tomorrow, friend.
pt-BR: Pronto. Nada de nada. Amanhã, mesma hora, amigo.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Voilà. Plus rien du tout. Demain, même heure, l'ami.
de: So. Gar nichts mehr. Morgen, gleiche Zeit, mein Freund.
pl: Proszę. Zupełnie nic. Jutro o tej samej porze, przyjacielu.

en: Morning. I think it is morning. It is always this.
pt-BR: Bom dia. Acho que é dia. Aqui é sempre assim.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Bonjour. Je crois qu'il fait jour. C'est toujours comme ça.
de: Morgen. Ich glaube, es ist Morgen. Es ist immer so.
pl: Dzień dobry. Chyba jest rano. Tu zawsze jest tak samo.

en: These do not come back when they pop. Neither do the ones on my side. Let us not talk about it.
pt-BR: Estes não voltam quando estouram. Nem os que estão do meu lado. Melhor não falar disso.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Ceux-là ne reviennent pas quand ils éclatent. Ceux sur mon flanc non plus. N'en parlons pas.
de: Die hier kommen nicht wieder, wenn sie platzen. Die an meiner Seite auch nicht. Reden wir nicht darüber.
pl: Te nie wracają, gdy pękną. Te na moim boku też nie. Nie mówmy o tym.

en: Tidy. You pop like somebody with nowhere to be.
pt-BR: Caprichado. Você estoura como quem não tem pra onde ir.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Propre. Tu fais éclater comme quelqu'un qui n'a nulle part où aller.
de: Ordentlich. Du lässt platzen wie jemand, der nirgendwo hinmuss.
pl: Porządnie. Rozbijasz jak ktoś, kto nigdzie się nie wybiera.

en: Tell me about the moon. No, wait. This first. I like having something to look forward to.
pt-BR: Me fale da lua. Não, espere. Isto primeiro. Gosto de ter algo pelo que esperar.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Parle-moi de la lune. Non, attends. Ça d'abord. J'aime avoir quelque chose à attendre.
de: Erzähl mir vom Mond. Nein, warte. Erst das hier. Ich freue mich gern auf etwas.
pl: Opowiedz mi o księżycu. Nie, czekaj. Najpierw to. Lubię mieć na co czekać.

en: Careful. A fish cannot swim into nothing. Cut them apart, and they never meet again.
pt-BR: Cuidado. Peixe não nada para o nada. Separe-os, e nunca mais se encontram.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Attention. Un poisson ne nage pas dans le vide. Sépare-les, et ils ne se reverront jamais.
de: Vorsicht. Ein Fisch schwimmt nicht ins Nichts. Trenn sie, und sie treffen sich nie wieder.
pl: Ostrożnie. Ryba nie wpłynie w nicość. Rozdziel je, a już się nie spotkają.

en: You still have not told me about the moon.
pt-BR: Você ainda não me falou da lua.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Tu ne m'as toujours pas parlé de la lune.
de: Du hast mir immer noch nicht vom Mond erzählt.
pl: Nadal nic mi nie mówisz o księżycu.

en: I used to count the fish going by. Then I named them. Then it got sad.
pt-BR: Eu contava os peixes que passavam. Depois dei nomes a eles. Aí ficou triste.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Je comptais les poissons qui passaient. Puis je leur ai donné des noms. Puis c'est devenu triste.
de: Ich zählte die Fische
pl: die vorbeizogen. Dann gab ich ihnen Namen. Dann wurde es traurig.

en: No rush. Nobody is waiting for us.
pt-BR: Sem pressa. Ninguém está esperando a gente.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Pas de hâte. Personne ne nous attend.
de: Keine Eile. Niemand wartet auf uns.
pl: Bez pośpiechu. Nikt na nas nie czeka.

en: That one was Doug. Goodbye, Doug.
pt-BR: Aquele era o Doug. Adeus, Doug.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Celui-là, c'était Doug. Adieu, Doug.
de: Das war Doug. Leb wohl, Doug.
pl: To był Doug. Żegnaj, Doug.

en: Everyone who came this close stopped talking, you know.
pt-BR: Todo mundo que chegou tão perto parou de falar, sabia?
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Tous ceux qui sont venus aussi près ont cessé de parler, tu sais.
de: Alle, die so nah kamen, haben aufgehört zu reden, weißt du.
pl: Wszyscy, którzy podeszli tak blisko, przestali mówić, wiesz?

en: You keep pressing buttons at me. I have decided that counts.
pt-BR: Você continua apertando botões pra mim. Decidi que isso conta.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Tu continues d'appuyer sur des boutons pour moi. J'ai décidé que ça comptait.
de: Du drückst weiter Knöpfe für mich. Ich habe beschlossen, dass das zählt.
pl: Wciąż naciskasz do mnie przyciski. Postanowiłam, że to się liczy.

en: Mm. Still you. Good.
pt-BR: Hum. Ainda é você. Que bom.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Mm. Toujours toi. Bien.
de: Mm. Immer noch du. Gut.
pl: Mm. Wciąż ty. Dobrze.

en: I set this one up while you slept. You do sleep? Something goes dark up there.
pt-BR: Montei este enquanto você dormia. Você dorme? Algo escurece lá em cima.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: J'ai préparé celui-ci pendant ton sommeil. Tu dors, non ? Quelque chose s'éteint là-haut.
de: Das hier habe ich aufgebaut, während du geschlafen hast. Du schläfst doch? Da oben wird etwas dunkel.
pl: Ułożyłam to podczas twojego snu. Śpisz w ogóle? Coś tam na górze gaśnie.

en: Do not rush. It is not as if we are late.
pt-BR: Não corra. Não é como se estivéssemos atrasados.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Ne te presse pas. Ce n'est pas comme si on était en retard.
de: Hetz dich nicht. Es ist ja nicht so, als wären wir spät dran.
pl: Nie spiesz się. Przecież się nie spóźnimy.

en: See? Not late.
pt-BR: Viu? Nada atrasados.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Tu vois ? Pas en retard.
de: Siehst du? Nicht zu spät.
pl: Widzisz? Bez spóźnienia.

en: Seven days. Not that I am counting.
pt-BR: Sete dias. Não que eu esteja contando.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Sept jours. Non pas que je compte.
de: Sieben Tage. Nicht, dass ich zähle.
pl: Siedem dni. Nie żebym liczyła.

en: You can go and look at the sky, you know. I would still be here. That is rather the point of me.
pt-BR: Você pode ir olhar o céu, sabia? Eu continuaria aqui. É meio que a minha função.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Tu peux aller voir le ciel, tu sais. Je serais encore là. C'est un peu tout l'intérêt de moi.
de: Du kannst ruhig den Himmel ansehen gehen. Ich wäre immer noch hier. Das ist so ziemlich mein Sinn.
pl: Możesz iść popatrzeć na niebo, wiesz? Nadal tu będę. W tym cała ja.

en: It is warmer down here lately. Have you noticed? Never mind.
pt-BR: Anda mais quente aqui embaixo. Você notou? Deixa pra lá.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Il fait plus chaud ici, ces temps-ci. Tu as remarqué ? Laisse tomber.
de: Hier unten ist es neuerdings wärmer. Ist dir das aufgefallen? Schon gut.
pl: Ostatnio jest tu cieplej. Czujesz to? Nieważne.

en: Do you miss the numbers? The big gold ones?
pt-BR: Sente falta dos números? Aqueles grandes e dourados?
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Les chiffres te manquent ? Les grands dorés ?
de: Fehlen dir die Zahlen? Die großen goldenen?
pl: Tęsknisz za liczbami? Za tymi wielkimi, złotymi?

en: No, do not answer. I like not knowing.
pt-BR: Não, não responda. Gosto de não saber.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Non, ne réponds pas. J'aime ne pas savoir.
de: Nein, antworte nicht. Ich weiß es lieber nicht.
pl: Nie, nie odpowiadaj. Wolę nie wiedzieć.

en: I kept one for you. No, I did not. They all went.
pt-BR: Guardei um pra você. Não, não guardei. Foram todos embora.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Je t'en ai gardé un. Non, c'est faux. Ils sont tous partis.
de: Ich habe dir eine aufgehoben. Nein, habe ich nicht. Sie sind alle weg.
pl: Zachowałam dla ciebie jedną. Nie, nieprawda. Wszystkie odeszły.

en: This one has a trick. Or it does not. I forget.
pt-BR: Este tem um truque. Ou não tem. Esqueci.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Celui-ci a une astuce. Ou pas. J'ai oublié.
de: Das hier hat einen Trick. Oder auch nicht. Ich habe es vergessen.
pl: Tu jest pewna sztuczka. Albo i nie. Zapomniałam.

en: I would help, but I am enjoying this.
pt-BR: Eu ajudaria, mas estou me divertindo.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Je t'aiderais bien, mais je m'amuse.
de: Ich würde ja helfen, aber das hier gefällt mir.
pl: Pomogłabym, ale dobrze się bawię.

en: Oh. That was the trick.
pt-BR: Ah. Era esse o truque.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Oh. C'était ça, l'astuce.
de: Oh. Das war der Trick.
pl: O. To była ta sztuczka.

en: I know. I just like asking.
pt-BR: Eu sei. Só gosto de perguntar.
notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. Never say 'free' or 'love'. Shown beside the board in a narrow box, about 118 px wide.
fr: Je sais. J'aime juste demander.
de: Ich weiß. Ich frage einfach gern.

pl: Bez pośpiechu, ale to już koniec. {move1} to cofnie.

notes: Ava, the anglerfish, in the secret ending where the player stays with her. She is FEMALE: use feminine forms for her. Never reveal the player's gender. Dry and calm, secretly fond. de: Schöner Versuch, nur nicht hierfür. {move1} bringt uns zurück.
pl: Ładna próba, tylko nie tutaj. {move1} nas cofnie.

en: Those ones have gone belly up. Bring the cursor to one and it pops.
